Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack 2 Songs of the Sand
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: This pack changes the music in the Calico Desert, randomizing three different songs from the SNES/N64 days.
Description:
This supplemental pack carries 3 songs to replace the Calico Desert Theme.  Each was handcrafted to give a desert feel.

**Listen to the music pack here!**
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/sounds-of-sand[/soundcloud]

Instructions are like other music packs.

1.  Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)

2.  Install [Custom Music by Platonymous](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043)

3.  Place this mod in the Mods Folder
If there is freezing issues **Check the config.json in Custom Music.  Set Covert to false if it says true.**
